about: Modal on native dialog. showModal() for top-layer + focus trap; Escape and backdrop close; focus returns to the opener. Enter/exit motion is CSS on --tk-motion-enter / exit (see modal.css).

description.about: One or two sentences under the title, read with it when the dialog opens (aria-describedby). Use it when the title alone does not say what is at stake; for a confirmation, it is the consequence.

alert.about: An alert dialog (role="alertdialog"): the kind that interrupts on purpose to confirm something that cannot be undone. Without a description it is described by its body, so the consequence is read when

actions.about: The footer's actions, as a ButtonGroup: end-aligned, equal widths, in reading order. Write them Cancel first, the action last (the action is the solid one, or the danger one). In a narrow dialog they

footer.about: Free footer content, for anything that is not a row of buttons.

closeOnBackdrop.about: Close when the backdrop is clicked. By default only a modal with no footer does: one with actions (a form, a confirmation) closes by its buttons, Escape or Close, so a stray click outside cannot throw

dismissible.about: false: a decision that has to be made. No Close button, Escape does nothing, a click outside does nothing; the only ways out are the actions, so give it at least two that both close it. For the rare c

returnFocusTo.about: Where focus goes on close when the opener is gone (the row that was just deleted, and its Delete button with it): the next thing to work on. Focus goes back to the opener whenever it is still on the p

a11y.name: its title
a11y.focus: moves into the dialog on open, stays inside while open, returns to the trigger on close

privacy.consent: The kit sends nothing: it dispatches tk:event on the page. A page that listens decides what to forward, and only under its own consent.
